confidence_interval: percentile bootstrap 95% CI over paired seed-level differences

interpretation.call_difference: candidate calls minus static calls; negative favours candidate
interpretation.error_difference: candidate wrong-hit rate minus static wrong-hit rate; negative means lower error
interpretation.budget_violation_rate: fraction of test seeds whose observed wrong-hit rate exceeded the nominal budget

warning: These are offline simulation results using dataset labels as oracle labels, not real LLM calls.
